text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product image, pure white background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, no person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire object fully visible. Ivory strapless sculptural rosette bust corset minidress, layered puff tulle hip skirt, ivory cutout floral lace thigh-high leggings with bows and rosettes, black gold strappy sandals.
original_prompt: Create a clean FLAT LAY product photograph on pure white: absolutely no upright mannequin silhouette. Lay this outfit and its empty flattened hosiery and empty shoes neatly on the white floor. No person, skin, legs, feet, toes, head or anatomical volume. No neck bow/ribbon if detachable. Use case: product-mockup. Professional photorealistic wardrobe catalog image, portrait 2:3, 1024x1536. Pure white seamless background, soft studio lighting, subtle contact shadow, accurate textile texture and original colors. Entire item(s) fully visible with generous white margins, no clipping. No text, watermark, label, collage, runway, background decor, person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin, hanger or stand. Hollow invisible mannequin garment presentation with empty openings; never fill openings with skin or a mannequin. STRICT: no legs or toes inside hosiery or shoes. Empty shoes, empty sleeves. Transparent fabric reveals white background, NEVER skin-tone fill. For lace, stockings or tights use an elegant flat lay with EMPTY hosiery laid separately beside clothing, no anatomical volume. Generate ONLY ONE garment ensemble: Ivory strapless sculptural rosette bust corset minidress, layered puff tulle hip skirt, ivory cutout floral lace thigh-high leggings with bows and rosettes, black gold strappy sandals. Retain matching visible footwear and hosiery. Remove all detachable bags, hats, glasses, jewelry, gloves, scarves, neckties, separate belts and hand props. Keep integral sewn decorations, garment self-ties and construction. Do not invent footwear where it is not visible. Input image 1 is design reference ONLY: select exclusively image 1, position top middle. Ignore every other outfit. Preserve this selected outfit silhouette, layers, fabric, trim and proportions, convert any illustration to real material. No people.
reproduction_note: 根据服装参考生成无人商品展示。遮挡或未展示的细节采用保守补全；文字和品牌细节仅为视觉参考。未进行逐图重新生成相似度验证。
